# scene

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/animation/scene"
```

Package scene draws whole scenes from the time alone: rain, snow, confetti, fireworks, stars, static and plasma. Non\-themable: colours are arguments. Experimental: its API may change in a minor release.

<a name="Scene"></a>
## type [Scene](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/animation/scene/scene.go#L39-L44>)

Scene plays behind content, or in place of it: rain, snow, stars, fireworks. It is drawn from the time alone, at any size, for as long as it lives; Still, it holds its first frame.
